hdhr.comment: Your HDHomeRun's IP address (the Settings page can find it). Several boxes: separate their addresses with commas and their tuners are pooled.

live.comment: Live TV in the guide: how many people can watch at once. Each viewer holds a tuner and converts the broadcast as it airs (about one CPU core each).

epg.comment: zip_code picks your over-the-air guide: a US ZIP or a Canadian postal code, or several separated by commas (for an antenna that reaches another market; where lineups overlap, the first code wins). Leave headend_id empty (it becomes USA-OTA<zip>-DEFAULT or CAN-OTA<postal code>-DEFAULT). Leave timezone empty to use this machine's (in Docker, the TZ variable). refresh_interval is in hours.

directories.comment: Where recordings go: TV/<Show>/Season NN/, Movies/<Title (Year)>/, Other/. In Docker this is /recordings.

ffmpeg.comment: 'ffmpeg' if it's on your PATH, otherwise the full path

recording.comment: quality: best | standard | smaller | 720p | original (see Settings for sizes). encoder: cpu | nvenc | qsv | vaapi (a graphics card that doesn't work falls back to cpu). vaapi_device: the card for vaapi, default /dev/dri/renderD128. sports_overrun_minutes: extra minutes added to a recording of a live game, and to one when live sports aired on the same channel in the 3 hours before it (games run long and push later shows back); 0 turns it off. captions: save the broadcast's closed captions as <recording>.en.srt beside the video. nfo: save a .nfo with the plot, air date, season and episode beside the video (Jellyfin, Emby and Kodi read it). comskip: after each recording, find the ad breaks (needs Comskip; the Docker image has it). comskip_mode: chapters (mark them as chapters plus a .edl; the video isn't changed) or cut (cut them out; the uncut original stays in <recordings>/.deleted for 7 days). comskip_ini: your own comskip.ini instead of the one shipped with LineDrive.

guide.comment: Major channel numbers of out-of-market stations your antenna also picks up (e.g. ["4", "5"]). When a local station carries the same show, LineDrive prefers the local one.

jellyfin.comment: Optional. With an API key, Jellyfin rescans as soon as a recording finishes. recordings_path is the recordings folder as Jellyfin sees it.

jellyseerr.comment: Optional. Lets Ask LineDrive request movies/shows ('download dune') through Jellyseerr -> Radarr/Sonarr.

sonarr.comment: Optional. After an episode records, LineDrive unmonitors it in Sonarr so Sonarr doesn't download it too. Only the episode's monitored flag changes; movies and sports are skipped.

mqtt.comment: Optional. Home Assistant integration via MQTT auto-discovery.

features.comment: Legacy torrent search/download/VPN commands (the prowlarr, indexer, torrent_client and vpn sections). Off by default.
